figures.derivation: The accounts split the surcharge in two and print no total: 2,420,109 thousand retained by the department and 200,769 thousand payable to the Consolidated Fund, which sum to 2,620,878 thousand, £2.62 billion, published here as £2.6 billion. The Migration Observatory's £2.4 billion for the same year is the retained half alone.
